id.description:
The id of the `input` element.
Use this prop to make `label` and `helperText` accessible for screen readers.

intent.description: Alters the border color and visual intent of the search input.

placeholder.description: The short hint displayed in the `input` before the user enters a value.

sdsStyle.description: Determines the visual style of the component, with options for rounded or square design.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

handleSubmit.description: This function is called when the Search icon is clicked, allowing user to handle the search operation.

value.description: The value of the `input` element, required for a controlled component.
